title: Database OOM crash, no restart
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the db component, memory OOM problem, and the API-version query as the trigger.
root_cause: The PostgreSQL container was killed by the OOM killer due to a memory‑intensive analytics query introduced in the new API version, leaving the data directory without pg_control and preventing the database from starting.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced an analytics dashboard query that makes PostgreSQL exceed its 1 GB memory limit; the database was killed (OOM, signal 9) and the container has no restart policy, so it stays down.
check_first: docker ps (or the container management tool) to verify the db container status
